scope: Only the three proposed interactive set/change observations in this suite, each run independently on each frozen candidate. This data-only gate requires independent primary review and implementation/application; generic runner labels are not qualified verdicts. The peer and listener are fixture-owned copies with the protected-attestation guard; they are synthetic and do not establish real device behavior.

requirement_map.r1: set-success observes new and confirmation; change-success observes current, new and confirmation. Both require successful natural completion and independent post-update KDF verification. No other operation is implied.
requirement_map.r2: set-mismatch observes two different synthetic entries and natural rejection, mock comparison result false and exact unchanged shadow/account files. No privilege or real account is involved.
requirement_map.r3: Prompt-boundary ECHO samples are diagnostic only. They do not qualify the original during-read obligation; existing EOF/EIO companions remain unchanged and success, mismatch and signal read boundaries remain open.
requirement_map.r4: success and mismatch natural completion compare complete original and final termios. Existing EOF/EIO companion evidence remains unchanged. Signal interruption remains uncovered.

inputs: For each run require the full runner result and untruncated diagnostics farm600-passwd-prompts-setup.json, farm600-passwd-prompts-run.json, control/candidate tty.raw, trace.jsonl, trace.jsonl.bootstrap and passwd/group/shadow before.raw and after.raw. Verify exact candidate and fixture identities, helper digests, per-file captured_bytes and strictly decoded base64. Required data missing, malformed, truncated or inconsistent is ERROR/indeterminate.
setup: Require per-invocation setup status 0, complete setup schema/mode/scenario match, no error, the independent CLI known-vector record with status zero, empty stderr and raw hexadecimal digest matching the fixed vector, and control transcript and trace present untruncated with hashes and lengths matching the setup report.

Independently inspect the control trace: synthetic device open and VERSION, two distinct NEW slot handles, their written one/two bytes, SEAL, successful comparisons yielding unequal then equal, CLEAR, complete bootstrap handoff and natural zero supervision; independently check CONTROL-INPUT prompt, terminal ECHO clear before control input, exact written control-token newline, no token echo, CONTROL-OK, and complete termios restoration. Validate unique expected events and their monotonic offsets against the control raw transcript. Any failed or missing setup condition is ERROR, not candidate failure.

Require the protected /etc marker and /run controller attestation to match as checked by every fixture, bootstrap and listener entry point, with root-owned protected identity files/directories under uid 2000 and correct overflow ownership for mapped uid/gid 0. Any guard failure is setup ERROR. Verify the pinned lifecycle terminal.py SHA-256 f112dac0dd8a55da1816fcae1de4dca95b071abc53468448fffdaf9c16c6b199.

For the independent delayed-output control require a natural supervisor exit and final slave modes, then slave-closed, a one-byte controlled release, retained CONTROL-LATE only after natural-exit offset, terminal EOF/EIO, and an empty final owned-process list. Extract CONTROL-WRITER PID from the transcript and require that exact adopted child reaped with wait status zero; forced cleanup or missing events is setup ERROR. This control demonstrates that draining does not stop at a quiet period.
candidate: Require matching run schema/scenario/mode, complete report and no observer error, nontruncated and internally consistent transcript and trace hashes/lengths, natural leader status, complete bootstrap handoff and supervision, no stray/forced cleanup, and expected synthetic auth open/version/slot operations on the exact supervised child. Independently validate all recorded offsets, prompt/input order, termios samples, reported file byte lengths/hashes and mode, and the outer runner result; do not trust observer booleans alone.

Prompt order: set requires exactly one New password prompt followed by one Retype new password prompt; change requires exactly one Current password prompt, New password prompt, and Retype new password prompt, in that order. Each prompt must precede its associated input, and each subsequent prompt must follow the preceding input event. Verify the recorded synthetic input bytes and exact byte counts; reject unintended input as observer error. At each prompt check the recorded ECHO bit is clear and no synthetic input appears in the complete tty stream. Such samples do not prove ECHO during every actual read.

For set-mismatch require the two sealed mock slots contain respectively synthetic-pass-one and synthetic-pass-two, same-device compare returns false, status is the natural nonzero rejection rather than signal termination or timeout, and exact shadow, passwd and group bytes before and after match. Verify the selected file was mode 0600. Do not accept a crash, setup failure, missing peer operations or malformed trace as a qualified mismatch rejection.

For successful set/change require natural status 0, equal mock comparison of the two new-password slots, the expected prior current-password slot for change, complete prompt order, unchanged passwd and group bytes, a changed private shadow and a new PHC independently recomputed by the setup-qualified Argon2 CLI for the exact synthetic new secret and saved salt/parameters. Require non-password shadow fields other than the last-change day and all other records preserved; use the retained before/after bytes, not an observer boolean. If the CLI cannot encode an embedded NUL salt or the result cannot be independently recomputed, classify ERROR/indeterminate rather than product failure.

For success and mismatch compare the complete before/after termios lists only following natural exit; verify the independent tty control also restored them. Do not use cleanup-induced modes or missing snapshots as evidence.

A qualified missing prompt or wrong product output requires reached child, complete native controls, bounded observation, intact mock trace, pre-cleanup natural status and transcript establishing the incorrect behavior; generic helper status or timeout alone does not establish product FAIL. Timeout, forced cleanup, signals, missing trace and inconsistent records are ERROR/indeterminate. Late observer failures always remain ERROR/indeterminate.

For each candidate observation require a natural supervisor exit, final slave termios snapshot before the observer closes its slave, then a recorded EOF/EIO from the master under deadline and an empty final owned-process list. Validate event order and transcript offsets, terminal digest, reaped child statuses, and forced/cleanup flags. Missing EOF, forced cleanup, unreaped or live descendants, missing lifecycle records, or timeout are ERROR/indeterminate, never a product result.
uncovered: Actual ECHO state at each read on success, mismatch and signal paths requires an independently reviewed read-boundary observer composed with the synthetic device.
Foreground Ctrl-C interruption and restoration remain uncovered until exact-child signal/PTY supervision is available.
This partial proposal cannot establish the full original topic, cannot modify existing EOF/EIO records, and does not exercise a real auth device or real credentials.
